chronology_cautions: 20:20 Sydney in the original is an author-text declaration, converted to 10:20 UTC; no filesystem mtime is used as a seal.
The inspected v3 closeout receipt records verification at 16:18:46 UTC on September 7, which is 02:18:46 Sydney on September 8. The inbox 02:21 is not established by this receipt.
The RV15 and RV5 primary completion receipts are 04:13:29.790569 and 05:16:40.533194 Sydney on September 8. Do not present inbox 04:14/05:17 as exact UTC or exact captured completion times.

v1 freeze supplies a date only and v2 freeze supplies no clock. Their prior results are recorded as known by the v3 local freeze at 08:18:58.166170 UTC. No precise v1/v2 execution times were found in the inspected receipts.

The inspected executable v4 freeze at 16:37:21.501511 UTC is later than the v3 closeout verification and links the conditional-text hash. This does not independently prove when the original conditional text was written or what anyone knew before the result.
Walk-forward means training and tuning consume only permitted past targets. It is causal training, not proof that target values or the historical design sample were unknown to researchers.

horizon_rationale.quote_exact: La información del flujo de opciones es de vida corta: la cobertura de los dealers actúa en minutos. Si B2 no mejora el pronóstico a 30 minutos, puede mejorarlo a horizontes más cortos. v4 cambia UNA cosa: el horizonte del objetivo.
horizon_rationale.role: Prior mechanistic hypothesis and horizon motivation; not evidence of actual dealer hedging.

closure.quote_exact: Si RV15 primaria rechaza H2 en al menos una familia tras H1, se reporta como resultado de esa familia y RV5 sólo como secundario. Se informa además si ambas familias rechazan; «al menos una» no tiene por sí solo control global 5% entre familias, ni entre versiones. Si ninguna rechaza, se cierra la investigación de este mecanismo con B1>B0 como resultado principal observado a 30 minutos y B2 no detectado a 30/15/5 según cada estimación e intervalo. No rechazo no establece equivalencia a cero ni absorción causal; «nulo informativo» describe el cierre, no una prueba de ausencia.
closure.original_predeclaration_success_quote: - Éxito: H2 rechazada al horizonte primario (15 min) en al menos una familia, con el resultado a 5 min reportado como secundario.
closure.original_predeclaration_failure_quote: - Si no: el proyecto se cierra con B1 > B0 como resultado principal y B2 como nulo informativo a 30, 15 y 5 minutos. No hay v5. Se pasa a la fase de organización y publicación.

public_readme_passages.text:
- El puente Fase 8 se abrió el 2026-08-30, con resultado mixto y correcciones
  descriptivas preservadas. [Addendum](reports/phase8a_exploratory_bridge_addendum_v13.md).

El puente Fase 8 conserva `MIXED_EXPLORATORY`: su auditoría concluyó
«no aggregation change» y «not confirmatory»; la sensibilidad materializada
mejoró sólo «one of eight B1-inclusive primary cells». Son diagnósticos
históricos, no la conclusión del programa cerrado en v4.

prior_bridge.reported_result: MIXED_EXPLORATORY; no aggregation change; not confirmatory; sensitivity improved only one of eight B1-inclusive primary cells.
prior_bridge.public_wording_es: La ventana puente declarada se solapa con 20 de las 25 sesiones finales, el 80 %. El README histórico describe su resultado como mixto y exploratorio, no confirmatorio, sin cambio de agregación; una sensibilidad sólo mejoró una de ocho celdas primarias que incluyen B1. Es una declaración histórica pública, no una nueva auditoría de ese puente.

holm.family_definition: Two contrasts times two model families within the RV15 primary window; comparability with the old bilateral Holm rule.
holm.formula: Sort the four stored bilateral p values ascending; at rank j=1..4 calculate min(1,max_{k<=j}((4-k+1)*p_sorted[k])). Return to original order.
holm.arithmetic: Decimal over the saved CSV decimal p strings; no resampling.

corrections_to_auditor.claimed: The bilateral p equals twice the one-sided p.
corrections_to_auditor.finding: Not supported by the saved bilateral output. Use p_bilateral, not an arithmetic doubling of p_raw.
Linear B2/B1 and tree B1/B0 survive; linear B1/B0 does not.

holm.interpretation: This sensitivity does not support the complete hierarchy in either family. Do not replace the predeclared fixed-sequence result, and do not describe the old Holm rule itself as sequential.

diagnostics.interpretation: HAC normal two-sided DM and asymptotic GW diagnostics accompany, and do not replace, the registered session-block bootstrap decision. GW is not the original fixed-window conditional-predictive-ability guarantee.

concentration.formula: d_s=Decimal(saved_loss_B1_s)-Decimal(saved_loss_B2_s); total=sum(d_s for all 25 sessions); fraction=d_2026_08_31/total; percent=100*fraction.
concentration.rounding_note: Exact decimal subtraction of displayed CSV values differs at about 1e-16 from binary values used by the frozen producer. Display 0.116248 of 0.119183, or 97.54%; do not claim byte-identical unrounded binary reconstruction.
concentration.interpretation: This percentage is the share of the net cumulative increment, not the share of all positive increments or total loss. The final window already has been observed; this is descriptive concentration.

sample.resampling_unit: Contiguous circular blocks of session-level paired losses after within-asset-session origin means and equal-asset aggregation; not asset-level independent resamples.
sample.correlation_evidence_status: No measured cross-asset correlation was supplied by the inspected aggregates; no correlation coefficient was calculated.
sample.interpretation: Six selected assets are the cross-sectional scope, not six independent replications. Session aggregation and session blocks preserve their joint session contribution; the saved evidence does not establish generalization to other sectors.

versions.wording: The linear H1 was not detected under the original formal bilateral Holm rule in v1 or v2. Positive estimates alone do not imply rejection; v2 has a positive stored percentile interval but a non-rejecting stored adjusted p.
versions.multiplication_limit: These are transparent post hoc sensitivity multiplications of saved nominal one-sided p values. They do not certify global control of the entire model or version search.

per_asset_linear_B2.interpretation: Descriptive signs, not six independent confirmatory tests.
Descriptive signs, not six independent confirmatory tests.
